entities.name: Kenzō Takada
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kenzō Takada  was a Japanese–French fashion designer living in France. He founded Kenzo, a worldwide clothing brand that also markets skincare and perfumes. Takada was the honorary president of the Asian Couture Federation.
